welcome_title: YOUR OLD PHONE IS SOMEONE'S FUTURE.
welcome_subtitle: The minerals in your drawer could power the next decade of innovation. We make sure they do.
digitize_drawer_desc: Snap a photo of your old tech. Our AI identifies components and estimates the raw material value in seconds.
free_pickup_desc: Schedule a time. Our carbon-neutral fleet arrives to collect your items, no packaging required.
earn_credits_desc: Once processed, receive credits instantly in your wallet. Spend them with our sustainable partners or cash out.
diverted_desc: Kilograms of e-waste safely diverted from landfills.
ai_check_desc: Optimized pickup routes divert ~12.4% more carbon emissions daily.
cta_desc: Ready to clear out your desk and receive instant carbon offsets?
circular_tagline: Empowering a circular world, one device at a time.
ewaste_insights_desc: E-waste contains precious metals, hazardous toxins, and incredible recycling potential. Explore the circular economy below:
phone_goldmine_desc: One metric ton of circuit boards contains between 40 and 800 times more gold than one metric ton of mined gold ore! Recycling 1 million mobile phones yields:
saving_power_desc: Creating electronics requires an intense amount of fuel and resource extraction. By recycling e-waste, we divert huge amounts of carbon emissions.
saving_power_highlight: Recycling just one laptop saves the energy equivalent to the electricity used by more than 3,500 average households in a year! Let's prevent massive resource burning.
toxic_footprint_desc: While electronics only represent around 2% of garbage in landfills, they are responsible for an overwhelming amount of toxic pollutants:
toxic_footprint_highlight: E-waste accounts for a massive 70% of heavy metals (lead, cadmium, mercury) in municipal landfills, contaminating water tables!
global_gap_desc: Globally, humanity generated 62 million tonnes of e-waste in 2022. This number is set to rise by 32% by 2030.
global_gap_highlight: Currently, only 17.4% of e-waste is formally collected and recycled! Your bookings help push this number higher.

no_bookings_desc: No bookings scheduled yet. Divert your old cables, phones, and laptops!
